title: Yellow Crunchy American Long Bean Skillet
description: A weeknight American dish featuring long-bean, shio-koji-cure, and a flexitarian-friendly approach, this skillet combines umami flavors with a crumbly texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the trimmed long beans, shio-koji, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook the long beans for 5 minutes, or until they are tender but still crisp.
In a small bowl, mix together the yellow cornmeal and grated cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle the cornmeal mixture evenly over the top of the long beans in the skillet.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and crispy.
